question: When was the National Human Rights Commission (NHRC) established to investigate cases of human rights violations in India?
solution: The correct answer is __**12 October 1993**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ • The **National Human Rights Commission (NHRC)** was established on **12 October 1993** under the provisions of the **Protection of Human Rights Act (PHRA), 1993**. • The NHRC is an independent statutory body tasked with the investigation and protection of **human rights** violations in India. • It was created to ensure compliance with the **Universal Declaration of Human Rights** and other international human rights treaties. • The Commission is responsible for protecting rights such as **life, liberty, equality, and dignity** guaranteed by the Constitution or enforceable by law. • The NHRC has the power to intervene in cases of **human rights violations by public authorities**, review laws, recommend policies, and conduct awareness programs.
